production_review.review: Raw injection validates and deserializes the requested ResponseItems, routes to the actual thread, and propagates errors.

Recovery checks feature, exact thread/tail/id/status and captured Core epoch, calls recover_turn_if_idle, and rejects invalid/busy/stale states; ephemeral listener history and paginated bounded history stay distinct.

Public recovery does not add new user input and preserves the turn id. Suspension is root-only, accepted work belongs to the session after caller disconnect, and waits for actual loop termination. Steer-only cannot become Started.
Injection routes into real session history and flushes persisted rollout; this is not a recorder-only fixture.
Recovery epoch is returned only for the exact idle candidate and matching turn epoch/persistence generation, with no shutdown or terminalization fence.

Recovery under active-turn ownership validates exact candidate generation, persisted context/environment and history boundary; settings drift rejects before a new provider send. Consumption and reservation remain explicit.
Steer-only retains active-turn/task/terminalization and expected-turn-id checks before queue admission.

Public handoff is bounded at 30s independently of the detached owner. Live descendant inventory, durable preflush, exact task claim, and first-poll witness are preserved. Unit-only helper omits only inventory.

Owned suspension retains the exact witness on panic/cancellation; task quiescing, input clearing, runtime stop, writer flush/close, lifecycle/event publication and final exact marker release remain ordered.
Existing production terminalizer watchdog is 30s; existing cfg(test) constant is 2s. This review changes neither.
SessionTask panic is caught and converted into the ordinary fatal terminalization path; attached task epoch and recovery identity remain actual.
Abort owns a detached scheduled job after claiming the complete task witness, so cancelling the public await does not discard cleanup.
Finish likewise claims a witness then runs the owned terminalizer detached from the public caller.
Finish/abort handoff drivers catch panic and use the watchdog while retaining exact failed-closed witnesses; successful release requires completed side effects.
The original skip_if_remote macro prints Skipping test in a remote test environment before returning. All original19 raw blocks were separately checked against the broad Skipping test prefix.
